title: PostgreSQL Overview
text: PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database management system that uses SQL and extends it with additional features. It supports complex queries, foreign keys, triggers, views, and transactional integrity.

title: MongoDB Overview
text: MongoDB is a document-oriented NoSQL database that stores records as BSON documents. It provides high scalability and flexibility for applications that require varied data formats.

title: Qdrant Vector Database
text: Qdrant is a vector similarity search engine and database written in Rust. It supports filtering on payload fields alongside ANN search, making it suitable for hybrid semantic + structured queries.

title: Linear Regression
text: Linear regression models the relationship between a dependent variable and one or more independent variables by fitting a linear equation. It is widely used for prediction and inference in statistics and machine learning.

title: TCP Protocol
text: The Transmission Control Protocol provides reliable, ordered, and error-checked delivery of data between applications over IP networks. Connection establishment uses a three-way handshake.
